author: shuijikou
body:
[here is a video on my personal record run, 544 with chimera(original/non fey)](https://b23.tv/9CCnFcO), for orn/exp gear I'm able to max 350+(al 50), my friends with 0 al able to 200+

For exp/orn endless it's a bit different from the video, buff stays the same but running with oracle (2× accessory+25%) and around 80k ward (50k without al)small mana potion all the way while maintain 2800hp for 1 move without dying to berserk, occasion stun on fallen rs(you are able to skip berserk damage while drinking potions)

author: Drunkturtle7
body: Towers I use spirit garm so he takes on mobs 1 by 1 (my cactus doesn't do enough to 1 shot) For endless too, but someone told me to use mammon acolyte with arcane buff (from a book that you get in the appolyon event). I haven't tried it because I don't have the book. Spiritgarm is also event locked so fjalar is a nice option.

author: shuijikou
body: for tower like others mention,i use arisen spiritgarm which i assume you don't have? Then i recommend fey cactus,slow but suitable

author: Markemberke
body:
For Towers I go Fey Cactus. :3 I love him, he clears floors like a beast. :D

I don't do endless dungeons tho.

author: Taboransky
body:
I can reach around floors 250-300 endless with orns gear with a tactic suggested by Fuximus iirc.  
Stance of Aegir + Book of Dragon + TMM as pet. Make sure to get all regular buffs and elem def + crit
